key.name: style
key.description: Match takes the top bar's own colour so the two join without a seam (black when the bar is see-through). Black, Graphite and Light are fixed.

key.name: accent
key.description: For the limit ring, today's bar and the focus timer.

key.name: placement
key.description: Top sits in the top bar at the very top of the screen, in place of the clock; Attached hangs from the bottom of the bar; Floating hangs just below it, rounded all round.

key.name: compact-left
key.description: The app in front, a status icon, or nothing.

key.name: compact-center
key.description: Today's screen time, or the time of day.

key.name: compact-right
key.description: A ring for the daily limit (when one is set), or nothing.

key.name: panel-sections
key.description: Any of: media (what is playing, with controls), today, week, apps, sites. Shown in that order.

key.name: open-on
key.description: Rest the pointer on the island, or click it.

key.name: hover-delay
key.description: How long the pointer rests on the island before it opens, so passing over it does not.

key.name: motion
key.description: Playful springs a little past its size; Calm settles without; Off jumps. The system's reduce-motion setting always wins.

key.name: monitor
key.description: The main display, or the one with the window you are using.

key.name: reserve-space
key.summary: Keep windows clear of the island
key.description: Reserve the height of the closed island under the top bar, so maximised windows start below it instead of under it.

key.name: alerts
key.description: Limits reached and reminders open the island for a few seconds.

key.name: greeting
key.description: Say good morning, afternoon or evening at the first activity of the day.

key.name: nickname
key.description: Used in the greeting. Empty uses your first name from the system.
